meta.name: sql-queries
meta.description: Generate SQL queries from natural language descriptions. Supports BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and other dialects. Reads database schemas from uploaded diagrams or documentation. Use when writing SQL, building data reports, exploring databases, or translating business questions into queries.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言描述生成SQL查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把业务问题转成SQL查询
copy.tagline_en: Generate SQL queries from natural language descriptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to translate business questions into SQL queries

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的自然语言描述生成 SQL 查询语句，支持 BigQuery、PostgreSQL、MySQL 等多种数据库。它会先读取你提供的数据库结构（如 SQL 文件或图表），然后生成带注释的优化查询，并解释逻辑。
howto.when: 当你需要编写 SQL 查询、构建数据报告、探索数据库，或者想把业务问题转成查询语句时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个查询，找出过去30天注册且至少有5次活跃会话的用户。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供数据库结构，然后生成 SQL。

say.text: 用 BigQuery 分析按地区和客户分层的年同比增长收入。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的 SQL 并解释逻辑。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate SQL queries from natural language descriptions, supporting BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and other dialects. It reads your database schema from uploaded files or diagrams, then produces optimized queries with comments and explanations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to write SQL, build data reports, explore databases, or translate business questions into queries.

say_en.text: Write a query to find users who signed up in the last 30 days and had at least 5 active sessions.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your schema and generate the SQL.

say_en.text: Create a BigQuery query for year-over-year revenue growth by region and customer tier.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the query and explain it.
